description: Analyze a slow query or DML statement on a temporary branch, returning its execution plan to suggest optimizations.

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to tune against; the temporary tuning branch is created from it. When omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database the statement runs against; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project that owns the database.

sql.description: The slow query or DML statement to analyze on a temporary branch; its execution plan is returned to suggest optimizations.

name: prepare_query_tuning
